label: Zadok

A.name: Zadok
A.line: made repairs to the wall of Jerusalem (NEH 3:4)
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:21)

B.name: Zadok
B.line: A leader of the people who sealed Nehemiah's covenant

why: A’s stated facts explicitly place him in this covenant list at Nehemiah 10:21. However, צָדוֹק appears between Meshezabeel and Jaddua without a patronymic or other identifying detail, so the text itself does not distinguish A from B.
